tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search across this framework's documentation set (README, AGENTS, ARCHITECTURE, PRODUCT, DECISIONS and everything under docs/). Returns the file path, the nearest heading and an excerpt for each hit. Read-only; it serves documentation, never customer records.

tools.name: get_capability
tools.description: Resolve a capability from the claims ledger by id (C-nn), by standing-limitation id (L-nn), or by topic. Every capability is returned together with the evidence that proves it and the limitation that bounds it — this tool cannot return one without the other.

tools.name: check_job
tools.description: Answer "can this framework do X?" against the CRM jobs-to-be-done index. Returns the matching jobs with their status (not supported / partially supported / technically supported / validated end to end), the tests that prove them, and an explicit answer when the truth is that the job is not supported
